faculty.name: David Barker
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits involved in drug addiction and comorbid disorders using anatomical, electrophysiological, and optogenetic techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾及相关障碍的神经环路，使用解剖学、电生理学和光遗传学技术。

faculty.name: Kasia Bieszczad
faculty.summary: Studies the neural substrates of information-rich memory in auditory associative learning, using electrophysiology and pharmacology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉关联学习中信息丰富的记忆的神经基础，使用电生理学和药理学方法。

faculty.name: Shana Cole
faculty.summary: Studies how cognitive, perceptual, and affective processes influence goal pursuit, using multi-method approaches to test self-regulatory strategies in various domains.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知、知觉和情感过程如何影响目标追求，并使用多方法测试各种领域中的自我调节策略。

faculty.name: Richard Contrada
faculty.summary: Studies psychosocial and emotional factors in chronic diseases, particularly coronary disease, using psychophysiological techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究慢性疾病（尤其是冠心病）中的心理社会和情绪因素，使用心理生理技术。

faculty.name: Maurice Elias
faculty.summary: Studies social-emotional and character development in students, focusing on emotional intelligence and school success.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学生的情感智能和社会情绪发展，关注情感智力和学校成功。

faculty.name: Samantha Farris
faculty.summary: Studies how anxiety and fear affect physical health and risk behaviors, using experimental methodologies to develop interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究焦虑和恐惧如何影响身体健康和风险行为，并使用实验方法学开发干预措施。

faculty.name: Jacob Feldman
faculty.summary: Studies how visual perception and categorization work by creating mathematical and computational models of human mental processes, focusing on simplicity and organization.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和分类的心理机制，通过构建数学和计算模型来模拟人类的认知过程，重点关注简洁性和组织性。

faculty.name: Luis Flores
faculty.summary: Studies the role of interpersonal processes in depression, particularly in emerging adults, using cognitive-affective and neuroscientific approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人际关系在抑郁症中的作用，特别是在青少年晚期，采用认知情感和神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Arnold Glass
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain encodes and retrieves information, creating computational models of simple cognitive tasks like detecting letter repetition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何编码和检索信息，创建检测字母重复等简单认知任务的计算模型。

faculty.name: Adam Gordon
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuits of motivated behavior, particularly substance use disorder and feeding, using fiber photometry, two-photon calcium imaging, and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动机行为的神经回路，特别是物质使用障碍和进食行为，使用光纤光度法、双光子钙成像和光遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Jessica Hamilton
faculty.summary: Studies risk factors for suicidal thinking and self-harming behaviors among young people, using technology like smartphone sensing and EMA.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年自杀念头和自伤行为的风险因素，使用智能手机传感和生态时刻评估等技术。

faculty.name: Pernille Hemmer
faculty.summary: Studies how people use prior knowledge and expectations to make decisions in complex environments, integrating episodic and semantic memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何在复杂环境中利用先验知识和预期进行决策，整合情景记忆和语义记忆。

faculty.name: Judith Hudson
faculty.summary: Studies memory development in children, the role of parent-child interaction in memory and time understanding, and the effects of emotion and odors on autobiographic memory and narrative construction.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童记忆发展、亲子互动对记忆和时间理解的作用以及情绪和气味对自传式记忆和叙述结构的影响。

faculty.name: Michelle Hurst
faculty.summary: Studies how cognitive processes related to mathematical and numerical reasoning vary across development and contexts, using behavioral experiments and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究数学和数值推理的认知过程如何随发展和情境变化，使用行为实验和计算模型。

faculty.name: Lee Jussim
faculty.summary: Studies social perception and its effects, using empirical methods to examine biases and accuracy in social judgments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会知觉及其影响，使用实证方法研究社会判断中的偏见和准确性。

faculty.name: Evan Kleiman
faculty.summary: Studies the prediction and prevention of suicidal thoughts and behaviors using ecological momentary assessment and ambulatory physiological monitoring.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用生态瞬时评估和可穿戴生理监测研究自杀念头和行为的预测与预防。

faculty.name: Alexander Kusnecov
faculty.summary: Studies how immune events influence cognitive and emotional states in mice, focusing on cytokines and anxiogenic neuropeptides.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究免疫事件如何影响小鼠的认知和情绪状态，重点关注细胞因子和焦虑肽。

faculty.name: Calvin Lai
faculty.summary: Studies implicit biases and develops interventions to reduce their effects on social behavior, including hiring and policing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究隐性偏见并开发干预措施以减少其对社会行为（如招聘和警务）的影响。

faculty.name: Alan Leslie
faculty.summary: Studies how abstract ideas like cause and effect and social agent emerge in early development through experiments with babies and preschool children.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究抽象概念如因果关系和社会代理在早期发展中的出现，通过婴儿和学龄前儿童的实验进行探索。

faculty.name: Teresa Leyro
faculty.summary: Studies the roles of cognitive-affective and biological vulnerability in substance use, particularly tobacco dependence and anxiety, using stress provocation paradigms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知情感和生物学易感性在物质使用障碍中的作用，特别是烟草依赖和焦虑，使用压力诱发范式。

faculty.name: Bridget Matikainen-Ankney
faculty.summary: Studies how obesity alters brain circuits involved in food-seeking behaviors over time, using molecular and systems-level techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究肥胖如何随着时间改变与食物寻求行为相关的脑回路，采用分子和系统水平的技术。

faculty.name: John McGann
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes and adapts to sensory stimuli, particularly odors, using optical imaging and pharmacology in rodent models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理和适应感官刺激，特别是气味，使用光学成像和药理学方法在啮齿动物模型中进行。

faculty.name: Melchi Michel
faculty.summary: Studies how humans integrate sensory information to make perceptual judgments, using probabilistic inference and ideal observers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何整合感官信息进行知觉判断，使用概率推断和理想观察者的方法。

faculty.name: Julien Musolino
faculty.summary: Studies what makes human intelligence distinctively human, focusing on language, rationality, agency, memory, and belief formation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类智能的独特性，关注语言、理性、代理、记忆和信念形成。

faculty.name: Gandalf Nicolas
faculty.summary: Studies how people and AI represent social groups and stereotypes, using behavioral experiments and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们和AI对社会群体和刻板印象的表征，使用行为实验和计算方法。

faculty.name: Yoobin Park
faculty.summary: Studies how close relationships influence people's lives, focusing on romantic relationships and their impact on health and well-being.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究亲密关系如何影响人们的生活，特别是浪漫关系及其对健康和福祉的影响。

faculty.name: Philip Parker
faculty.summary: Studies how visual behaviors are processed in the brain using optogenetics and neural recordings in natural settings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉行为的神经基础，使用光遗传学和神经记录技术在自然环境中进行实验。

faculty.name: Erin Reilly
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes like learning and decision-making in individuals with eating disorders during treatment, using neurocognitive methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究进食障碍患者在接受治疗期间的认知过程，如学习和决策，使用神经认知方法。

faculty.name: Benjamin Samuels
faculty.summary: Studies how chronic stress exposure changes behavior in mice and how neural circuits can reverse these effects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究慢性应激暴露如何改变小鼠行为及其神经回路如何逆转这些影响。

faculty.name: Diana Sanchez
faculty.summary: Studies racial identity and gender roles in close relationships, focusing on perceptions and experiences of multiracial and biracial individuals, and how gender role investment affects psychological.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究种族身份和亲密关系中的性别角色，关注多种族和混血个体的感知和经历，以及性别角色投资如何影响心理健康。

faculty.name: Edward Selby
faculty.summary: Studies emotion dysregulation and self-sabotaging behaviors in personality disorders and eating disorders, using models like the Emotional Cascade Model.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪调节障碍和自我破坏行为在人格障碍和进食障碍中的作用，使用情绪级联模型等理论。

faculty.name: Manish Singh
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain represents geometric information and generates layered surface representations, using psychophysical experiments and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何表示几何信息并生成分层表面表示，使用心理物理学实验和计算模型。

faculty.name: Karin Stromswold
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive and neural basis of language, using cross-linguistic, behavior genetic, and neuroimaging approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言的认知和神经基础，使用跨语言、行为遗传学和神经成像方法。

faculty.name: Valerie Jones Taylor
faculty.summary: Studies intergroup relations, stereotype threat, and virtual reality interventions to improve racial attitudes and identity safety.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究群体关系、刻板印象威胁以及虚拟现实干预措施以改善种族态度和身份安全感。

faculty.name: Elizabeth Torres
faculty.summary: Studies primate motor learning and adaptation, using electrophysiology and computational methods to derive indexes of performance in stroke and Parkinson’s patients, with applications to autism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物的运动学习和适应，使用电生理学和计算方法来推导出在中风和帕金森病患者中的表现指标，并应用于自闭症的治疗方法。

faculty.name: David Vicario
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of vocal learning in songbirds, focusing on sensory-motor integration during vocal communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究鸣禽的神经基础，关注发声学习中的感觉-运动整合。

faculty.name: Juli Wade
faculty.summary: Studies hormonal and genetic factors regulating brain structure and behavior using songbirds and lizards.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究激素和遗传因素如何调节大脑结构和行为，使用鸣禽和蜥蜴作为模型系统。

faculty.name: Jenny Wang
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn mathematical concepts, exploring the roles of visual attention, memory, language, and social factors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习数学概念，探索视觉注意力、记忆、语言和社会因素的作用。

faculty.name: David Wilder
faculty.summary: Studies social psychology phenomena, including attitudes, group behavior, and interpersonal relationships.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会心理学现象，包括态度、群体行为和人际交往。

faculty.name: Qiong Zhang
faculty.summary: Studies how the human memory system retrieves past experiences efficiently, using computational modeling, behavioral methods, and neural imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类记忆系统如何高效检索过往经验，采用计算建模、行为方法和神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Kostas Bekris
faculty.summary: Studies robotic rearrangement and manipulation, using NSF grants and collaborations with industry.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究机器人重新排列和操作，使用NSF资助和与工业的合作。

faculty.name: Ahmed Elgammal
faculty.summary: Develops algorithms for image recognition and generation, using machine learning techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发图像识别和生成的算法，使用机器学习技术。

faculty.name: Konstantinos Michmizos
faculty.summary: Studies neuromorphic computing and its applications in robotics and artificial intelligence, using computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经形态计算及其在机器人和人工智能中的应用，使用计算方法。

faculty.name: Vladimir Pavlovic
faculty.summary: Develops machine learning and computer vision techniques for biomedical informatics.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发机器学习和计算机视觉技术，用于生物医学信息学。

faculty.name: Matthew Stone
faculty.summary: Studies artificial intelligence and its applications, focusing on language technology and design justice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人工智能及其应用，特别是在语言技术和设计正义方面。

faculty.name: Kristin Dana
faculty.summary: Studies computer vision, pattern recognition, and machine learning to develop innovative approaches in robotics and computational photography.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究计算机视觉、模式识别和机器学习，开发创新的机器人和计算摄影方法。

faculty.name: Mark Baker
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes using computational models and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用计算模型和行为实验研究认知过程。

faculty.name: Kristen Syrett
faculty.summary: Studies language acquisition and the interface between syntax and semantics, using experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言习得及句法与语义的接口，采用实验方法。

faculty.name: Bruce Tesar
faculty.summary: Studies computational learning and parsing in phonology using Optimality Theory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语音学中的计算学习和解析，使用优化理论。

faculty.name: Michael Glanzberg
faculty.summary: Studies the nature of linguistic meaning and the role of mathematical techniques in the empirical study of language.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言意义的本质以及数学技术在语言实证研究中的作用。

faculty.name: Zoe Jenkin
faculty.summary: Studies the role of reasons in perception and cognition, and the scope of epistemic evaluability.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究理由在感知和认知中的作用，以及知识评价的范围。

faculty.name: Ernest Lepore
faculty.summary: Explores the philosophy of language, logic, and mind, collaborating with colleagues on various books and papers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言哲学、逻辑学和心灵哲学，与同事合著多部书籍和论文。

faculty.name: Brian McLaughlin
faculty.summary: Explores the mind-body problem and metaphysical issues in psychology, focusing on supervenience, emergence, and vagueness.
faculty.summary_zh: 探讨心灵-身体问题和心理学中的形而上学问题，关注 supervenience、涌现和含糊性。

faculty.name: Paul Pietroski
faculty.summary: Studies the relationship between grammatical structure and linguistic meaning, using psycholinguistic experiments to explore how words relate to concepts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究句法结构与语言意义之间的关系，通过心理语言学实验探讨词汇与概念之间的联系。

faculty.name: Jake Quilty-Dunn
faculty.summary: Explores philosophical questions about the mind and cognitive processes, including language and aesthetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 探讨心灵和认知过程的哲学问题，包括语言和美学。

faculty.name: Susanna Schellenberg
faculty.summary: Explores the nature of mental content, perceptual experience, and evidence in epistemology and philosophy of mind.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉内容、知觉经验和证据在认识论和心灵哲学中的本质。

faculty.name: David Zald
faculty.summary: Studies the links between brain structure and function and psychopathology using MRI and PET imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用MRI和PET成像研究大脑结构和功能与心理障碍之间的联系。

faculty.name: Adam McCollum
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and the phonology-phonetics interface using laboratory methods with Central Asian and West African languages.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究音系学和音系-音素界面，使用实验室方法研究中亚和西非语言。

faculty.name: Victoria E. Abraira
faculty.summary: Studies fundamental principles of sensory neurobiology, focusing on spinal cord circuits.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉神经生物学的基本原理，集中在脊髓回路方面。

faculty.name: Gary Aston-Jones
faculty.summary: Studies cognition and addiction, exploring the cognitive processes involved in addictive behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知与成瘾，探索成瘾行为中的认知过程。

faculty.name: Annika Barber
faculty.summary: Studies neural signal integration in Drosophila behavioral circuits.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究果蝇行为回路中的神经信号整合。

faculty.name: Maureen M Barr
faculty.summary: Studies sensory biology, innate behaviors, and neuroplasticity in C. elegans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉生物学、先天行为和秀丽隐杆线虫的神经可塑性。

faculty.name: Nicholas T. Bello
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis for food preferences and how metabolism controls eating behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究食物偏好的神经基础以及新陈代谢如何调控进食行为。

faculty.name: Alison Bernstein
faculty.summary: Studies epigenetic changes and environmental factors contributing to sporadic Parkinson's disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究环境暴露和表观遗传变化在散发性帕金森病中的作用。

faculty.name: Detlev Boison
faculty.summary: Studies metabolism and disease modification in epilepsy and traumatic brain injury, using neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究癫痫和创伤性脑损伤的代谢和疾病修饰机制，采用神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Li Cai
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of neural development and regeneration after injury.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育和损伤后的再生的分子和细胞机制。

faculty.name: Sangmi Chung
faculty.summary: Studies GABAergic interneuron-associated brain disorders using iPSCs, genomics, and chimeric mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与GABA能中间神经元相关的脑部疾病，使用iPSCs、基因组学和嵌合小鼠。

faculty.name: David P. Crockett
faculty.summary: Studies neural plasticity in response to spinal cord injury and traumatic brain injury.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脊髓损伤和创伤性脑损伤后的神经可塑性。

faculty.name: Santiago Cuesta
faculty.summary: Studies brain health and neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑健康和神经科学。

faculty.name: Brian Daniels
faculty.summary: Studies infection and inflammation in the central nervous system.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究中枢神经系统中的感染和炎症.

faculty.name: Robin L. Davis
faculty.summary: Studies how sensory signals develop, focusing on molecular mechanisms that control auditory function in ontogeny.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉信号的发育及其分子机制如何调控听觉功能的发展。

faculty.name: MD Emanuel DiCicco-Bloom
faculty.summary: Studies cellular and molecular regulation of neurogenesis and its effects on brain development in animal models of autism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发生细胞和分子调控及其对自闭症动物模型脑发育的影响。

faculty.name: Cheryl F. Dreyfus
faculty.summary: Studies the role of trophic factors in neural cell survival and death, using cellular and molecular methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经营养因子在神经细胞存活和死亡中的作用，采用细胞和分子方法。

faculty.name: Monica Driscoll
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular genetics of neurodegeneration and aging, focusing on mechanotransduction.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经退行性疾病和衰老的分子遗传学，重点关注机械转换机制。

faculty.name: Gabriella D’Arcangelo
faculty.summary: Studies molecular mechanisms of neuronal proliferation, differentiation, and migration.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元增殖、分化和迁移的分子机制。

faculty.name: Isaac Edery
faculty.summary: Studies biological clocks and circadian rhythms in Drosophila using photic signal transduction and PAS-containing transcription factors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究果蝇的生物钟和昼夜节律，使用光信号转导和PAS含转录因子。
